summary: The lab's first end-to-end fine-tuning window: a QLoRA (NF4) run with torchtune on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct over a public French instruction set of about a thousand examples, on a single RTX 3090, followed by a resume-from-checkpoint test on a deliberately interrupted run. The run completed with a steadily falling loss and modest VRAM use, and resuming from an interrupted run was proven. Recipe, the trainer's logged loss points (first steps and last step) and aggregate figures only (data/forge/); no dataset or adapter is published.
title: Fine-tuning reference run: QLoRA on one card
